name: Aegiochusmon
look: a red-skinned goat-legged god-man with tattoos, a fur mantle, long white hair, curled horns and white armoured thigh-guards
entry: A god-man with goat's legs who carries a storm on its back. Its fists come down with the force of a lightning strike, and the ground cracks wherever it plants its hooves.
how: Wild: rare in hills, plains and mountains.
